name: Rumble Spikehead
description: Draw the head back in a shortening glide along the chain that ends in a strike at the opponent's brow.

name: Indomitable Hingecap
description: Drive the iron-shod haft butt into the ground and brace behind it against a charging blow.

name: Gust Looping
description: Pivot on the ball of the foot in time with the swing so the head arrives on the beat of the turn.

name: Flailinsight
description: Spread the qi field into the circling head and feel the air shift where an opponent stands.

name: Swingthru Scourge
description: Bring the circling head down again and again on one spot until the guard beneath it sags.

name: Titanic Chainring
description: Land two blows on a shield's face in quick beats so the second breaks what the first loosened.

name: Torrent Handstaff
description: Spin the head around the body in a tight orbit that knocks aside close blows from any side.

name: Overbearing Chainlink
description: Whip the chain around an opponent's weapon arm at the elbow and pull his guard wide.

name: Gustflail
description: Charge the head with qi and drop it overhead like an anvil onto a raised guard to drive it down.

name: Blazegimbal
description: Circle the head overhead on a rising spiral of qi then bring it down in one hammer fall through guard and weapon alike.

name: Wheelwrath
description: Open a duel by whirling both heads in a half circle that ends with both aimed at the opponent's centre.

name: Impenetrable Swivel
description: Lock both hafts together before the chest so they take a blow as a single bar.

name: Unseen Flailhead
description: Take a sidestep that moves each head into the line the other has just left.

name: Wheelscourge
description: Let the left head trail the right by half a beat so the foe parries one and meets the other.

name: Keen Swingarm
description: Read the opponent's grip and balance through the tension in both chains at once.

name: Gyvethresh
description: Cross the chains over a blade and pull them apart like scissors to wrench it off its line.

name: Rebound Ruin
description: Let the heads fall in rapid alternation so there is no gap between one blow and the next.

name: Thornswivel
description: Rotate both heads in counter-turning rings that cover high and low at the same time.

name: Iron Headball
description: Strike with the head the foe is not watching the instant his eye fixes on the other.

name: Threshscourge
description: Land both heads together on opposite sides of a guard so it is crushed between them.

name: Ponderous Lashout
description: Circle both chains around an opponent in crossing loops and draw them tight to hold him still.

name: Berserk Linkband Devastation
description: Hold both heads in one high orbit until the opponent steps wrong then bring them down in a single paired blow.

name: Gust Headball
description: Bend the head's path around the curve of a blow so a counterswing leaves the blow behind.

name: Ghosting Thresh
description: Retreat in a slow bend across shallow ground so the opponent follows into the head's reach.

name: Chime Hingecap
description: Test the opponent's pressure on the chain and read where his push will turn.

name: Flailhead Tenacity
description: Hook the head under a rival weapon at the bank of the guard and lever it out of position.

name: Wheelhavoc
description: Let a blow carry past then swing the head up from behind it into the exposed flank.

name: Granite Rebound
description: Curve every swing in a long bend so each blow meets the opponent from the side he guards least.

name: Decimating Handstaff
description: Join the opponent's blow into the swing at first touch and send both along one line into him.

name: Hoarfrost Chainlink
description: Wind the chain in a tightening whirl round a weapon until it is wrenched from the grip and flung aside.

name: Obdurate Waning Swingarm
description: Take a crushing blow on the chain and bend it back along its arc so its full force returns to the attacker.

name: Ruinous Swingthru
description: Sink into a deep basin stance and let the head fall from the shoulder on the downbeat.

name: Ghosting Wheel
description: Stamp hard on the landing step so the stamp and the blow arrive as one jolt.

name: Aegis Chainring
description: Hold the haft overhead in both hands to turn blows aside like rain off a roof.

name: Radiant Swivel
description: Feel through the chain the tremor of an opponent's step before his weapon moves.

name: Blazewheel
description: Chop the head in short quick falls from a gathered chain onto a guard before the chest.

name: Granite Spikehead
description: Roll the head in a growing orbit that builds weight and sound before it falls.

name: Mayhem Linkband
description: Shove the haft against an opponent's chest on the rim of his stance and strike as he rocks back.

name: Torrent Hingecap
description: Cross the chain over the head to meet a descending blade and fling it off to the side.

name: Shattering Lashout
description: Drop the head twice in one beat with a clap of iron and a shudder through the guard.

name: Wheel Devastation
description: Raise the head on a slow qi-gathered orbit and hammer it down hard enough to split ground and guard.

name: Ironswivel
description: Release every stored turn of the swing into one falling blow that shakes the stance of anything it touches.

name: Might Flailhead
description: Swing the head along the track the opponent's own weapon just made to hit where he has opened.

name: Might Swingthru
description: Step along the same track as the opponent in a mirror so his blows find no new angle.

name: Adamantine Chainlink
description: Angle the haft like a mirror so a blow glances off it back toward the attacker's side.

name: Verity Swivel
description: Watch the opponent's first three swings and learn the rhythm that holds them together.

name: Spikehead Scourge
description: Whip the head back along the line it travelled so the same strike lands again as an echo.

name: Rumblegimbal
description: Seize the instant of the opponent's recovery and send the head down the track he just left.

name: Aegisgimbal
description: Spin a vertical orbit that copies the angle of an incoming blow and meets it edge to edge.

name: Glamour Chainring
description: Swing along two apparent tracks in turn so the opponent cannot tell which will carry the strike.

name: Thornwheel
description: Wrap the chain along the opponent's blade track while he tries to recover and tie his weapon up.

name: Gustgimbal
description: Match the opponent's strike exactly in speed and angle and return it a hair earlier.

name: Hoarfrost Rebound
description: Weave the chain through the opponent's recurring swing track until his own rhythm pulls him into the coils.

name: Tempered Thresh
description: Circle the head along the track of his strike and cut the line of power at the wrist.

name: Thresh Wrath
description: Catch the opponent's finest strike in a chain loop and fling the head down its own track with all its weight.

name: Might Swingarm
description: Bend the swing like a reed in wind so the head arrives from a slant the opponent cannot square to.

name: Siltthresh
description: Sway the body from side to side on small steps so the head leaves from either shoulder.

name: Gimbalnerve
description: Yield to a blow with a bending guard that lets the blow slide along the haft.

name: Waning Headball
description: Run the full meridian net into the chain and feel the opponent's tension from his side of it.

name: Blistering Handstaff
description: Swing the head then let the weighted butt of the haft follow it as a second blow from the other end.

name: Indomitable Headball
description: Whip the chain in a thin supple ring that skims aside darts and cuts without setting hard against them.

name: Fastening Wheel
description: Hook the haft behind the opponent's knee while the head holds his weapon arm away.

name: Gyvegimbal
description: Run a net of qi down the chain so it clings and tightens round whatever it touches.

name: Looping Devastation
description: Bend the swing at the last instant so a falling head changes line and lands on a guard already set.

name: Ferocious Linkband
description: Cycle head and weighted butt in one unbroken spiral so each lands while the other is parried and together they break the guard.

name: Lacerating Rebound
description: Take the oath stance with the haft low and swing the head up from the flat of the plateau.

name: Unbowed Chainring
description: Test the ground with the heel and settle to take a heavy blow without sliding.

name: Lightning Lashout
description: Step to put the wind on the same bearing as the swing so it adds to the blow.

name: Acute Hingecap
description: Hold the chain still in a sworn grip and listen for the pull of any weapon upon it.

name: Gimbalruin
description: Run along the plateau's edge with the head swinging across so the foe has no room to dodge toward the drop.

name: Gyveswivel
description: Cinch the chain about a rival's weapon wrist and hold fast until he yields the weapon.

name: Facet Spikehead
description: Turn the haft broadside to shelter the body behind a moving guard that breaks wind and blow alike.

name: Hellish Handstaff
description: Swing the head round the body in a rolling circle that gathers speed across the flat ground.

name: Decimating Looping
description: Take a bearing on the opponent and cut the head back through the same line he moves on.

name: Shattering Swingarm
description: Bring the head down with a gust at the back to land a crushing weight on the guard.

name: Toxin Lashout
description: Circle the head wide and steady to push the opponent step by step toward the plateau's edge.

name: Chainlink Reckoning
description: Swear the blow to the wind itself and drop the head with the gale's weight to break guard and stance.

name: Tempered Swivel
description: Cast the head along a taken bearing across the rim so it arrives at the opponent's centre.

name: Silt Linkband
description: Slip downwind of the opponent's weapon to leave its swing short and the head free to answer.

name: Chimegimbal
description: Hold the chain steady against a crosswind so the head's path does not drift from its bearing.

name: Unerring Chainring
description: Read the distance to the rim's drop by the sound of wind past it and set each swing by it.

name: Hoarfrost Spikehead
description: Whirl the head at the rim's edge so any rush must break through a ring of swinging iron.

name: Granite Wheel
description: Keep one bearing as the opponent circles and meet each pass with the same swing along it.

name: Ponderous Swingthru
description: Hook the chain behind the knees and pull the foe toward the drop he has been avoiding.

name: Looping Ruin
description: Sweep the head wide across the rim so every foot of open ground before the user is struck.

name: Swingthru Nerve
description: Drop the head on the opponent's lead foot along a taken bearing and pin it with chain tension.

name: Gustswivel
description: Hold the bearing through every feint until the one true line opens then release the whole body's force along it.

name: Wheelruin
description: Swing a heavy head with the wind at the back so the weight carries the arms through.

name: Unassailable Flailhead
description: Squat low against the wind with the haft planted to hold a heavy blow without sliding.

name: Might Handstaff
description: Walk with the head's weight kept low and the steps planted so the swing never drags the body off line.

name: Devastating Thresh
description: Let a rising gust lift the head and loft it onto a target above shoulder height.

name: Chimeswivel
description: Turn the body about the head's weight so a blow meets only the weapon's swinging edge.

name: Hellish Headball
description: Hold the heavy head in a slow orbit and let the wind keep its weight up until the strike drops.

name: Swivelscourge
description: Let a gale pass behind the head and hammer a charged blow onto the guard with the full wind weight.

name: Charter Flailhead
description: Plant head and haft together on the ground as a stand and hold against any push that comes.

name: Corroding Rebound
description: Bind the full weight of the wind and the body into the head so it falls as a mass that breaks stone and guard.

name: Sanguine Linkband
description: Set the head whirling across the wind so it cuts the gust and gains speed.

name: Siltgimbal
description: Pivot at the turn of a gust so the swinging head turns with the wind and not against it.

name: Chime Swingarm
description: Let the whirling head meet a blow and use a gust to carry it out and past.

name: Waning Hingecap
description: Read which quarter the wind blows from and note how it drags the chain.

name: Swivel Reckoning
description: Throw the head out with a twist of the haft so it spirals in the crosswind into the target.

name: Mangling Chainlink
description: Bend the head round a guard on a crosswind and land it on the unprotected side.

name: Aegis Linkband
description: Spin the head fast enough that its whirl becomes a moving curtain against blows and thrown iron.

name: Enthralling Wheel
description: Lash the chain round a weapon on a gust and twist to take it from the hand.

name: Rumble Looping
description: Join each whirl of the head to a step so the strikes come from a new angle every pace.

name: Slagwheel
description: Whirl the head until it rains blows from every side upon all who stand near.

name: Gyvewheel
description: Cast the chain across the wind so it curls around a distant opponent's arm and drags him in.

name: Gimbalwrath
description: Build the whirl through three turns of the body into a cyclone of chain and head that strikes without pause.

name: Swingthru Ruin
description: Loose the whirl all at once as a squall of iron that breaks through every guard in its line.

name: Lashout Wrath
description: Launch the head from below the hip along a rising line that climbs with the gust.

name: Granite Swingarm
description: Spring up on the toes with the swing so body and head rise together.

name: Aegis Headball
description: Lift the haft in a rising guard that catches a downward blow at its start.

name: Waningflail
description: Feel the warm air rising from the ground through the chain and judge how the head will climb.

name: Iron Hingecap
description: Hook the head up under the jaw or armpit as the opponent steps in.

name: Tempered Rebound
description: Spiral the head upward along the opponent's arm so the spikes drag as they climb.

name: Obdurate Handstaff
description: Lift the head under a falling blade and let the rising wind carry it over the shoulder.

name: Chime Chainlink
description: Drag the chain upward across a guard to lift the arms and open the body.

name: Ruinous Thresh
description: Drive the head upward in a qi-charged surge that lifts a guard and the foe beneath it.

name: Devastating Looping
description: Loft the head high on an orbit that climbs with the updraft then drop it like a stone.

name: Merciless Sanguine Flailhead
description: Throw the head up on the wind then recall it down on the opponent so rise and fall are one stroke.

name: Might Lashout
description: Swing only in the lull between gusts so the head runs true and the opponent misjudges the wind.

name: Flailvalor
description: Hold the breath in a steady stance so the body gives no sign of the coming move.

name: Swivelvortex
description: Move between gusts and stop with them so the opponent hears no step.

name: Gust Spikehead
description: Cast the head out between gusts in a long even throw that the wind cannot bend.

name: Unbudging Flailhead
description: Wait for the opponent's breath to fill and turn his strike aside as it begins.

name: Hogtying Swivel
description: Slip a loop of chain onto the opponent's weapon so quietly he feels it only when it tightens.

name: Grievous Swingarm
description: Hold the swing in the lull then loose it the moment the gale returns for the blow it carries.

name: Looping Fortitude
description: Let the full meridian net settle the swing into a stillness that smothers the opponent's sudden moves.

name: Might Chainring
description: Stay motionless through the last held breath then loose the whole stored swing in one blow as the gale breaks.
